decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:115%">Prior to the first occupation of any part of
the building by a new occupier, other than a use falling within Class E, full details of
the proposed cycle parking, to include a minimum of 16 additional long-stay spaces,
and a the 20 retained short-stay spaces shall be submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:115%">The approved cycle parking shall be fully
implemented prior to occupation and retained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town
and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), the educational use
(Use Class F1a) hereby permitted shall be limited to higher education, further
education, adult education, vocational training and healthcare-related
educational uses only. 

The premises shall not be used as a primary
school, secondary school, academy, free school or any other compulsory
school-age educational establishment without the express grant of planning
permission by the Local Planning Authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

• Site Plan as Proposed: PL17297-S1 Rev.A;

• Basement Plan as Proposed: PL17297-FP-01 Rev.A;

• Ground Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-FP-02 Rev.A;

• First Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-03 Rev.A;

• Second Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-04 Rev.A;

• Third Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-05 Rev.A;

• Fourth Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-06 Rev.A;

• Fifth Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-07 Rev.A;

• Sixth Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-08 Rev.A;

• Seventh Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-09 Rev.A;

• Eighth Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-10 Rev.A;

• Ninth Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-11 Rev.A;

• Tenth Floor Plan as Proposed: PL17297-12 Rev.A;

• Elevation A as Proposed: PL17297-E-01 Rev.A;

• Elevation B as Proposed: PL17297-E-02 Rev.A;

• Elevation C as Proposed: PL17297-E-03 Rev.A;

• Elevation D as Proposed: PL17297-E-04 Rev.A;


Documents: 

• Planning[SJ8.1], Design and Access Statement (Be First, July 2026);

• Area Schedule (Plan London);

• Transport Statement (TPP, July 2026); 

• Travel Plan (TPP, July 2026) 

• Fire Strategy (S2 Partnership Ltd, 21 October 2024); 

• Letter from marketing agent (Strettons, 22 September 2026);


No other drawings or documents apply.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:115%">The proposed development shall achieve
security standards (based on Secured by Design principles) to the satisfaction
of the local authority &amp; Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be
provided to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval prior to the
first occupation of any part of the building&nbsp;by a new occupier, other than a use falling
within Class E <o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:115%">All security measures applied to the
approved development shall be retained thereafter for the lifetime of the
development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:115%">Notwithstanding the details shown on the
approved plans, prior to commencement of relevant works, details of two (2) accessible
parking spaces, including bay layout, dimensions, transfer zones, signage and
management arrangements, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:115%">The approved accessible parking spaces shall
be provided prior to the first occupation of any part of the building by a use
other than a use falling within Class E, and retained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p>

Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to commencement of the relevant works, full details of the proposed boundary treatment and associated landscaping shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:

·       height, appearance and specification of all fencing and gates;

·       materials, colour and finish;

·       details of retained planting;

·       details of additional planting and greening measures;

The approved details shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of any part of the building by a use other than a use falling within Class E, and retained thereafter.
